title: Translation and style
summary: Translate between Turkish and English as translators do: unpack long words and left-branching sentences, render `-mIş`, `-DIr` and the dropped pronoun in natural English, read a text's style from its sentences, words, register and rhythm, and handle *hüzün*, *gurbet*, *keyif* and formulas such as *Kolay gelsin* that have no English twin.
canDo: Unpack a long Turkish word or sentence into natural English, and build participles and noun clauses from English
Translate -mIş, -DIr and dropped pronouns by what they do in context
Describe the style of a Turkish text and keep its register in translation
Handle words and formulas that have no English equivalent
